title: botrychium lunarioides
intro: Botrychium lunarioides, commonly known as moonwort, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Ophioglossaceae. It is native to North America and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of moonwort include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of moonwort include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to exert therapeutic actions such as analgesia and anti-spasmodic effects.
